text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's finally arrived, hasn't it? The day 
of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A stage made possible thanks to the 
cooperation of everyone at both Hanshin 
and Kyoto Racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rice has to do her best too.
choice_data_list:
Go out there and live up to everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! If everyone's waiting for me, 
I'll answer them with my running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is a useless girl, but... She might 
cause you trouble, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is going to do everything she can, 
giving it her absolute all, right to the 
very end!
